notes: Built from the approved build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/corsair_A17/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/corsair_A17.py). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the class length (LENGTH 14.5, the Cruiser) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. No parts list here: the sheet places every part. game_code C15s_23 is the Cruiser folder the game picks for corsair (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old recipe cruiser there, copied aside first. bake none until the sheet paint stack (issue 601) lands. Stage 3 does not trace or tune a sheet hull; it fits the concept camera and reports the outline.
